name: Vector Calculus
summary: Vector fields, line and surface integrals, divergence and curl, and the theorems of Green, Stokes and Gauss that underpin physics and engineering.

topics.name: Vector fields (vector calculus): conservative fields and potential functions
Line integrals of scalar functions and vector fields; work
Fundamental theorem for line integrals and path independence
Divergence and curl: meaning and identities
Curvilinear coordinates: grad, div, curl and Laplacian in cylindrical and spherical coordinates
Applications to fluid flow, electromagnetism and conservation laws
Preview of differential forms and the generalised Stokes theorem
